subject: VP/CTO alignment call — three slot proposal & next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@fastretail.com>, Gordon Li <gordon.li@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: VP/CTO alignment call — three slot proposal & next steps

Hi Asha / Gordon,

Great follow-up from today's discovery. Quick recap so we have alignment before we lock the next conversation: 
- Pilot objective: integrate Redwood inference to reduce latency for catalog search reranking and reduce per-token inference cost by at least 40% relative to current endpoint.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 120ms for search flows, embedding throughput 1.2k reqs/minute, and <$0.015 per query token-equivalent.
- Data flow & security: customer-side filtering -> hashed tokens -> requests to Dedicated or Private deployment. You flagged SOC2 + audit logging as gating.

Next step to unblock internal sign-off: short VP/CTO alignment (20–30m) so your execs and ours can confirm architecture, cost SLOs, and rollout runway. Proposing three options (all in PT):
  1) Tue Sep 12 — 10:00–10:30 PT (13:00–13:30 ET)
  2) Wed Sep 13 — 08:30–09:00 PT (11:30–12:00 ET)
  3) Thu Sep 14 — 16:00–16:30 PT (19:00–19:30 ET)

Attachments: FR-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan / milestones), redwood-security-brief.docx (high level security + compliance artifacts).

If you can confirm one of the slots, I will send a calendar invite with a short agenda and list of expected attendees. If none work, tell me two preferred windows and we'll match. Also, if procurement/legal should be on the call, please loop them in.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Perfect — locking Tue Sep 12 10:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (will send invite to confirmed attendees).

Proposed 20-minute agenda:
  - 3m: Intros + objective framing (Asha)
  - 8m: Redwood technical plan & deployment options (Karthik + Mateo)
  - 6m: Cost/ops tradeoffs and expected rollout (Marissa)
  - 3m: Confirm actions + decision inputs

Quick answers: we recommend showing Dedicated capacity for pilot (predictable latency and easier data controls) but will outline Hosted fallbacks and a Private plan if compliance requires on-prem. Karthik will present latency profiles and quantization options.

Attached: FR-MAP-v1.pdf (milestones). I'm including a one-page security summary in the invite for Gordon; Karthik will attach the deeper security doc in a follow-up.

Marissa — can you own the invite and include the security one-pager and the mutual action plan? Karthik — can you prepare two slides: (1) expected p95/p99 latency tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Hosted for our target sequence lengths, (2) quick runway/cost estimate for a 3-month pilot?

Thanks — Mateo

Thanks all — confirmed on Sep 12 slot. I'll lead the technical portion and cover:
- Latency benchmarks (p95/p99) for the model families we discussed
- Deployment choices: Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private (ops + TCO bullets)
- Security & audit logging overview (attaching redwood-security-brief.docx)

Requests for prep so we make the most of 20 minutes: please share a representative sample query/traffic profile (peak/minute, typical sequence length), and any hard SLOs (e.g., max acceptable p99). If you can drop that in reply or into the HubSpot deal (link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/FR-2028-058) before EOD Mon Sep 11, we'll tailor the slides.

See you Tue — Karthik
